lines: I'm sure I told him to bring you guys here when Hebiko-chan was torn to pieces and not much more than a lump of meat♪
Sorry, but I'm the impatient type.
While I made a quip, I confronted Snake Lady with the readiness to be able to attack at any moment. Howeverー
(What? I can't move my body... I don't sense any deadly intent from this woman, and she's even unarmed and full of openings...)
My, my♪ You ruined the dramatic set-up♪ But welcome, you must be the Fuma boy♪
Yes. No need for the hospitality, we're just here to take Hebiko home with us.
Oh, you can't do that♪ The schedule has gotten slightly off track, but it's finally time for the main act♪
As the Snake Lady blew a kiss, a gate opened in the air.
(No, the truly terrifying one is the other enemy. A warrior with the lower body of a snake... This must be... a Nagi!)
I remembered reading about them in the archives of Gosha Academy. Even among the demons they were knowns as noble and powerful, and it was said that one Nagi was worth a thousand normal warriors.
Hotaru-senpai, that snake monster is dangerous! It's a highly skilled Nagi warrior... probably a Nagi Soldier.
Yes... Fuma-kun, give us orders. We're okay, with our strength and your orders we can win.
H-Hebiko will do her best as well...! One more fight, two more fights... It doesn't make much difference!
Even though Shikanosuke was screaming in fear, he was prepared for battle.
Alright, here we go! Commence the battle!
